title: Trigonometric Identities
standard_text: P.5L use trigonometric identities such as reciprocal, quotient, Pythagorean, cofunctions, even/odd, and sum and difference identities for cosine and sine to simplify trigonometric expressions
meta_desc: Free Precalculus worksheets on trigonometric identities for Texas TEKS P.5L: Pythagorean, reciprocal, quotient, cofunction, even/odd and sum and difference identities. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Write everything in sine and cosine.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Reciprocal: csc θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, cot θ = 1/tan θ. Quotient: tan θ = sin θ/cos θ.
  • Pythagorean: sin2 θ + cos2 θ = 1, 1 + tan2 θ = sec2 θ, 1 + cot2 θ = csc2 θ.
  • Cofunction: sin(90° − θ) = cos θ. Even/odd: cos(−θ) = cos θ, sin(−θ) = −sin θ.
  • Sum and difference: sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B; cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B.

Answer: cos θ

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
sin(−θ) = sin θSine is odd: sin(−θ) = −sin θ.
cos(90° − θ) = cos θIt equals sin θ.
sin(A + B) = sin A + sin BUse the sum identity.

faq.q: Where do the Pythagorean identities come from?
faq.a: x² + y² = 1 on the unit circle.

items.e: sin² θ = 1 − (14)² = 1516, so sin θ = ±√154. In Quadrant II sin is positive, so sin θ = √154.

items.q: Which expression is equal to sec(−θ)?
items.e: Sine, tangent, cosecant and cotangent are odd: f(−θ) = −f(θ). Cosine and secant are even: f(−θ) = f(θ). sec θ.

items.q: Which expression is equal to 1 − cos² θ?
items.e: Divide sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 by cos² θ or sin² θ, or rearrange it. sin² θ.

items.q: Which expression is equal to csc(−θ)?

items.q: Simplify (1 − sin² θ) / cos θ.
items.e: 1 − sin² θ = cos² θ, and cos² θ / cos θ = cos θ. cos θ.

items.q: Simplify cot θ / csc θ.
items.e: (cos θ/sin θ) · sin θ = cos θ. cos θ.

items.q: Simplify sin(−θ) csc θ.
items.e: sin(−θ) = −sin θ, and −sin θ csc θ = −1. −1.

items.q: Simplify cos θ · tan θ.
items.e: tan θ = sin θ/cos θ, and cos θ cancels. sin θ.

items.q: Simplify sin θ · cot θ.

items.e: Difference of squares: (sin² θ − cos² θ)(sin² θ + cos² θ), and the second factor is 1. sin² θ − cos² θ.

items.q: Simplify cos² θ (1 + tan² θ).

items.q: Find the exact value of cos 285°.
items.e: Write 285° = 240° + 45° and use cos(A + B) = cos A cos B − sin A sin B. The result simplifies to √6 − √24.

items.e: This is the expansion of cos(75° + 105°) = cos 180° = −1.
